0022600026.text: The Celtics (6-2, 2nd in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back) have won six of their last ten and are 1-2 on the road, but they will be without Jayson Tatum (rest) and Devin Carter (illness), while Payton Pritchard (eye abrasion) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The Hornets (3-6, 4th in the Southeast, 2 games back) have lost five straight, and Grant Williams (hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (leg soreness) are both out. Boston won 2-1 against Charlotte in the 2025-26 season, including a 113-102 win in Boston in their most recent meeting on April 7, and the two teams have not yet played each other in 2026-27.
